residual.estimand: observed-window residual dispersion after individual low-degree polynomial fits, descriptive only
residual.fit_scale: raw VAS; centered actual minutes, least squares; no interpolation or clipping
residual.report: residual SSE/(n-p) and actual adjacent residual MSSD; no measurement-error separation, no individual AR or latent instability claim

burden.integration: exact area and first time moment of piecewise-linear observed VAS segments
burden.split: midpoint of each interval: 10.5 or 5.5 min; area zero gives undefined centroid/fraction

functional_depth.method: grid modified band depth: fraction of all pairs containing each value, trapezoid-weighted over time; ties included
functional_depth.tie_rule: include all curves tied at the ceil(n/2) cutoff
functional_depth.output: deepest curve and central envelope, no outlier removal, envelope not confidence band

bootstrap.role: pointwise descriptive percentile ranges; no calibrated inference

signal_audit.P_role: previously authorized rest supplement, retain label
signal_audit.scope: all distinct linked acq/snirf headers and whole snirf numeric validity, no artifact acceptance threshold or physiology associations
signal_audit.units: read metadata only; do not infer physical unit or dose synchronization
signal_audit.hash_scope: full inspected files, not headers only

missingness_scenarios.status: bounds_and_observation_support_done; numerical clinical scenarios remain unspecified
